topic: 事件标签继承与路由选择
title: 真实Zabbix事件标签：继承与宏展开区分同名问题，历史事件不被重贴标签
answer:
```json
{"tags": [{"tag": "environment", "value": "lab"}, {"tag": "service", "value": "payments"}, {"tag": "owner", "value": "{HOST.HOST}"}]}
```

原题知识说明：
稳定标签可表达服务、环境和责任团队，用于动作筛选与关联。宏展开结果需验证，动态时间或请求ID会增加噪声，不能把秘密放标签。

conversion.original_title: Tags如何帮助动作与事件关联？

body:
## 操作任务
提交trigger-tags.json，只有tags列表，每条含tag/value。保留environment=lab，叠加service=payments和owner={HOST.HOST}，owner要求展开技术Host name而非Visible name；主机已有site=private由Zabbix继承，不复制或改写主机配置。真实server生成两个标题、严重性和主机均相同但service不同的问题，按已保存的service与site事件标签应只选payments事件。验证宏展开、原标签ID及另一个trigger不变；后续由夹具修改trigger新配置时，既有事件标签快照保持原值，目标恢复也不关闭另一个问题。不能缺少service、用显示名替代技术Host name或按标题归并事件。

## 提交产物
trigger-tags.json

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32/PG15.19/trapper及event_tag继承、宏展开和事件快照；用对真实事件表的明确标签谓词验证路由选择，不执行Action或发送通知，不宣称邮件/企业微信/工单送达。仅向私有目标trigger叠加配置，原host tag、既有environment tag ID、保护trigger和历史保持。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 提交trigger-tags.json，只有tags列表，每条含tag/value。保留environment=lab，叠加service=payments和owner={HOST.HOST}，owner要求展开技术Host name而非Visible name；主机已有site=private由Zabbix继承，不复制或改写主机配置。真实server生成两个标题、严重性和主机均相同但service不同的问题，按已保存的service与site事件标签应只选payments事件。验证宏展开、原标签ID及另一个trigger不变；后续由夹具修改trigger新配置时，既有事件标签快照保持原值，目标恢复也不关闭另一个问题。不能缺少service、用显示名替代技术Host name或按标题归并事件。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,json,time,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with PrivateServer() as s:
 d=s.db
 d.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private tag host',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends) VALUES(1000201,1000000,2,'Target state','event.state',3,'1d','0'),(1000301,1000000,2,'Other state','other.state',3,'1d','0'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000201),(1000301); INSERT INTO triggers(triggerid,expression,description,priority) VALUES(1000202,'{1000203}=1','Same summary',3),(1000302,'{1000303}=1','Same summary',3); INSERT INTO functions(functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter) VALUES(1000203,1000201,1000202,'last','$'),(1000303,1000301,1000302,'last','$'); INSERT INTO host_tag(hosttagid,hostid,tag,value) VALUES(1000204,1000000,'site','private'); INSERT INTO trigger_tag(triggertagid,triggerid,tag,value) VALUES(1000205,1000202,'environment','lab'),(1000305,1000302,'service','inventory')")
 s.start()
 def sample(key,n):
  item=1000201 if key=='event.state' else 1000301;stamp,ack=s.send(n,key=key);assert 'processed: 1; failed: 0;' in ack['info']
  s.wait(lambda:d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid='+str(item)+' and clock='+str(stamp//1_000_000_000)+' and ns='+str(stamp%1_000_000_000))==[[str(n)]],'actual event source sample')
 def reload_complete():
  offset=s.log.stat().st_size;subprocess.run(['zabbix_server','-c',str(s.config),'-R','config_cache_reload'],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
  s.wait(lambda:'finished forced reloading of the configuration cache' in s.log.read_text()[offset:],'current tag configuration loaded')
 def problems():return d.execute('select eventid,objectid,name from events where source=0 and object=0 and value=1 order by objectid,eventid')
 sample('event.state',0);sample('other.state',0)
 protected=d.execute('select triggertagid,triggerid,tag,value from trigger_tag where triggerid=1000302')
 hosts=d.execute('select hosttagid,hostid,tag,value from host_tag where hostid=1000000')
 functions=d.execute('select functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter from functions where triggerid in(1000202,1000302) order by functionid')
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:apply_trigger_routing_tags',flush=True)
 patch=json.loads(pathlib.Path('trigger-tags.json').read_text())
 if patch=={'tags':[]}:raise NotImplementedError('provide additive routing tags')
 assert isinstance(patch,dict) and patch.keys()=={'tags'} and isinstance(patch['tags'],list) and 1<=len(patch['tags'])<=10
 pairs=[]
 for tag in patch['tags']:
  assert isinstance(tag,dict) and tag.keys()=={'tag','value'} and all(isinstance(tag[k],str) and 0<len(tag[k])<=128 for k in ('tag','value'))
  pairs.append((tag['tag'],tag['value']))
 assert len(pairs)==len(set(pairs)) and ('environment','lab') in pairs,'existing environment tag must remain'
 for i,(tag,value) in enumerate(pairs):
  if d.execute("select count(*) from trigger_tag where triggerid=1000202 and tag='"+tag.replace("'","''")+"' and value='"+value.replace("'","''")+"'")==[['0']]:
   d.execute("insert into trigger_tag(triggertagid,triggerid,tag,value) values("+str(1000400+i)+",1000202,'"+tag.replace("'","''")+"','"+value.replace("'","''")+"')")
 reload_complete();sample('event.state',1);sample('other.state',1)
 s.wait(lambda:len(problems())==2,'actual two same-title problems')
 target=next(row[0] for row in problems() if row[1]=='1000202')
 tags=d.execute('select tag,value from event_tag where eventid='+target+' order by tag,value')
 assert tags==[['environment','lab'],['owner','training-node'],['service','payments'],['site','private']],tags
 routed=d.execute("select e.objectid from events e where e.source=0 and e.object=0 and e.value=1 and exists(select 1 from event_tag t where t.eventid=e.eventid and t.tag='service' and t.value='payments') and exists(select 1 from event_tag t where t.eventid=e.eventid and t.tag='site' and t.value='private') order by e.objectid")
 assert routed==[['1000202']]
 assert all(row[2]=='Same summary' for row in problems())
 print('NATIVE_EVENT_TAGS_INHERIT_HOST_SITE_EXPAND_HOST_MACRO_AND_DISAMBIGUATE_SAME_SUMMARY',flush=True)
 # Later trigger configuration changes cannot rewrite the already-created event snapshot.
 d.execute("update trigger_tag set value='later-policy' where triggerid=1000202 and tag='service'");reload_complete()
 assert tags==d.execute('select tag,value from event_tag where eventid='+target+' order by tag,value')
 sample('event.state',0)
 s.wait(lambda:d.execute('select triggerid,value,state from triggers where triggerid in(1000202,1000302) order by triggerid')==[['1000202','0','0'],['1000302','1','0']],'target recovers while other problem stays')
 assert d.execute('select triggertagid,triggerid,tag,value from trigger_tag where triggerid=1000202 and triggertagid=1000205')==[['1000205','1000202','environment','lab']]
 assert protected==d.execute('select triggertagid,triggerid,tag,value from trigger_tag where triggerid=1000302')
 assert hosts==d.execute('select hosttagid,hostid,tag,value from host_tag where hostid=1000000')
 assert functions==d.execute('select functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter from functions where triggerid in(1000202,1000302) order by functionid')
 assert d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000201 order by clock,ns')==[['0'],['1'],['0']]
 assert d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000301 order by clock,ns')==[['0'],['1']]
 print('NATIVE_EVENT_TAG_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE_AFTER_POLICY_CHANGE_OTHER_TRIGGER_UNTOUCHED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
